results.name: No RPC API keys in network requests
results.summary: None of the 46 recorded requests carries an RPC API key.
results.source: network log (HAR) Kane CLI recorded during the "browse" run
results.fix: Remove provider API keys from frontend code. Use a keyless public RPC for read calls, or route keyed calls through a server-side proxy. Treat any key that was shipped as leaked and rotate it.

results.name: No testnet, staging or local endpoints in a mainnet build
results.summary: None of the 46 recorded requests goes to a testnet, staging or local endpoint.
results.source: network log (HAR) Kane CLI recorded during the "browse" run
results.fix: Point every RPC and API call at production endpoints for  (chain ID 1). Load endpoints from one config per environment so testnet URLs cannot ship to production.

results.name: Scripts only load from trusted hosts
results.summary: Kane's network recording shows 1 script loaded from 1 untrusted host.
trace: first seen in Kane's recording as request 2 of 46, 0.0 s into Kane's run
results.source: network log (HAR) Kane CLI recorded during the "browse" run
results.fix: Remove scripts loaded from third-party CDNs, or bundle them with the app. Every script that runs on a dApp page can read and change what the user signs, so drainers are often injected this way.

results.name: No private keys or seed phrases in browser storage
results.summary: While Kane used the page, the site saved 8 items in browser storage and none is a private key or seed phrase.
results.source: browser storage, watched live over the Chrome DevTools Protocol in the Chrome that Kane CLI drove

results.fix: Never store private keys, seed phrases or signing secrets in localStorage or sessionStorage. Any script on the page can read them. Keep only public data, such as the wallet address, and leave signing to the wallet.
results.objective: Go to http://localhost:4173 and wait until the page has fully loaded. If the page is taller than the window, scroll down and back up. If it fits in the window, skip scrolling. Assert: the page shows its main content and not an error page.
